mapper.select: SELECT p1.ProductId,p1.Name,p1.Brand,p1.CategoryId,p1.Price,ps.ShopId,ps.ShopName FROM product p1 LEFT JOIN product_shop ps ON p1.ShopId = ps.ShopId WHERE CategoryId = #{categoryId} AND p1.Status = 0 LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT DISTINCT pps.ProductId, pps.Name, pps.Brand,pps.CategoryId, pps.Price, pps.ShopId,pps.ShopName FROM ( SELECT p.ProductId, p.Name, p.Brand,p.CategoryId, p.Price , ps.ShopId, ps.ShopName FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_shop ps ON p.ShopId = ps.ShopId WHERE p.Name LIKE '%${name}%' UNION ALL SELECT p.ProductId, p.Name, p.Brand,p.CategoryId, p.Price , ps.ShopId, ps.ShopName FROM product p LEFT JOIN product_shop ps ON p.ShopId = ps.ShopId WHERE p.Brand LIKE '%${name}%' ) as pps LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT p.ProductId,p.Name,p.Price,sum(o.Count) AS Count FROM product p LEFT JOIN `order` o ON p.ProductId = o.ProductId WHERE p.`Name` LIKE '%${keyWords}%' AND p.Status=0 GROUP BY p.ProductId ORDER BY sum(o.Count) DESC LIMIT 2;
